interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
